transcript.question: Is Cameron Coscia's aggressive, high-volume roster management actually setting The Stinky Faggots up for a title, or is it papering over a team that just lost to a 6-2 opponent by six points and can't be trusted come playoff time?

hotSeat.why: Nina Sharpe is favorite on them (+72), Curtis Vaughn is neutral on them (+9)

sides.mel-diaper: Nine waiver pickups and a churning bench prove Cameron Coscia is stocking the depth and draft capital this roster will need in January.
sides.reggie-banks: The Stinky Faggots are 5-3 and just dropped six points to a first-place team — the scoreboard says the churn hasn't fixed anything yet.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Good evening. The Stinky Faggots sit 5 and 3, dropped a six-point decision to Chodie mcgruber in week eight, and remain the most active team on waivers with nine pickups this season. So: is Cameron Coscia building this roster right? Mel, take it away.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: NINE PICKUPS. NINE! And this week Cameron Coscia added Will Reichard and the 49ers D/ST for ZERO DOLLARS with $76 of $100 still in the bank. Rico Dowdle at pick 176 — I'll say it plain, I had him wrong, and it hurts like hell. Bijan Robinson second overall, Cam Skattebo at 146. That's a title core. THE STINKY FAGGOTS BEAT GLORY ASSHOLE IN WEEK NINE. Six-point losses are not a goddamn diagnosis.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots beat GLORY ASSHOLE in Week 9.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Cute draft, Mel. Now the scoreboard: 105.4 in week seven, 116.9 in week eight. Two straight weeks under 120 and two straight losses. Nine pickups and the last one that mattered was a free kicker. GLORY ASSHOLE takes week nine at home — projected 140 to 129.7 — and I don't care where you took Bijan. GLORY ASSHOLE wins. That's my flag.

claim.text: GLORY ASSHOLE beats The Stinky Faggots in Week 9.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: TWO WEEKS UNDER 120?! Reggie, week six that lineup put up 185.4 — Bijan Robinson 35.8, Rico Dowdle 33.9, Cam Skattebo 31.0. That's SEVENTY-SIX POINTS of draft capital in one afternoon. And week eight the bench was 19.7. NINETEEN POINT SEVEN. That's a finished lineup, not a shitshow. Josh Allen 24.2, Jaylen Waddle 20.9, Khalil Shakir 20.8 and they still lost by six — that's a schedule, not a build.
factsCited: M8 - Week 6 The Stinky Faggots 185.4 vs Moisty Loins
M8 Bijan Robinson 35.8, Rico Dowdle 33.9, Cam Skattebo 31.0
M20 - Week 8 bench points 19.7, Josh Allen 24.2, Jaylen Waddle 20.9, Khalil Shakir 20.8, margin 6.1

managerMentions.evidence: And week eight the bench was 19.7. NINETEEN POINT SEVEN. That's a finished lineup, not a shitshow.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class, the claim: week eight was schedule, not shitshow. Grade: partly supported. The Stinky Faggots scored 116.9 against Chodie mcgruber's 123, a six-point margin, with 19.7 bench points — that is a tight, well-managed lineup. But week seven, 105.4, is the number Mel skipped. One clean week doesn't erase the other. Two-game sample, hold it loosely.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Thank you, Nina — 105.4 is the number, and I'll take that grade with a grin. Mel, here's the one you skipped: week eight, Cameron Coscia spent ZERO on Will Reichard and ZERO on the 49ers D/ST while sitting on $76. Meanwhile GLORY ASSHOLE dropped $17 on Oronde Gadsden and he went out and put up 18.7 that same week. That's a fucking swing. Free bodies don't score.

GLORY ASSHOLE dropped $17 on Oronde Gadsden and he went out and put up 18.7 that same week.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: FREE BODIES DON'T SCORE?! GLORY ASSHOLE spent $17 on Gadsden and still lost by 39.1 to IM NOT GAY — 182.3 to 143.2. SEVENTEEN DOLLARS OF NOTHING. And the $0 bodies you're mocking? Cameron Coscia is at $76 of $100 with NINE pickups. That's the whole goddamn point: depth for free, capital in the bank, and Gabe Coscia paying retail for a bullshit loss.

managerMentions.evidence: Cameron Coscia is at $76 of $100 with NINE pickups.
Gabe Coscia paying retail for a bullshit loss.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Mel, you brought me a loss to argue about? Fine. GLORY ASSHOLE is 5-3 with 1107 points. The Stinky Faggots are 5-3 with 1094.2. Same record, less scoring, and 105.4 last time out. And week nine that lineup is projected at 129.7 — the low number on the whole slate. Capital in the bank is horseshit if it never gets spent. Walt, settle it.

managerMentions.evidence: Same record, less scoring, and 105.4 last time out.

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: The record on this doesn't go back further than this season, so I'll stay inside it. Cameron Coscia has spent 24 of 100 dollars and won five games; Gabe Coscia spent 17 on one tight end and lost by 39.1 anyway. Money spent isn't a plan, it's just money spent. My verdict: Mel's right about the build, Reggie's right that 105.4 is a real number and not an excuse. But you don't bench a nine-pickup, five-and-three roster off two rough scoreboards. I'll take the process here.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Walt's called it inside the season. Let's project forward — Dex, is week nine's Gadsden money REPORTED or just Reggie's OPINION on value?

turns.speaker: dex-alvarez
turns.text: REPORTED: Gadsden, $17, week eight, outbid IR Squad's $8. That's the log. His 18.7 that week is also REPORTED. Whether $17 was worth it — that's Reggie's OPINION, flagged as such. I don't grade value. I file the bid.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: DEX SAID IT — $17, OUTBID EIGHT, AND STILL A 39.1-POINT LOSS. Now the receipt Reggie won't read: GLORY ASSHOLE's bench in week eight was 11.8. ELEVEN POINT EIGHT. That roster is EMPTY behind the starters. The Stinky Faggots put THREE running backs over 31 in one week — Bijan 35.8, Dowdle 33.9, Skattebo 31.0 — and Skattebo cost pick 146. DEPTH IS THE PLAN, and 129.7 is a projection, not a goddamn scoreboard.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Enough gun metaphors. Nina, grade it plainly: is a five-and-three record with the lowest points-for among the five-and-threes a sign of a build that's working or one due for correction?

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class. The claim: lowest points-for among the five-and-threes means correction due. Partly supported. The Stinky Faggots sit at 1094.2, fourth seed, below GLORY ASSHOLE's 1107 and SAGGY NUTS' 1096.4 — that part's real. But record is 5-3, same as both. Three games. Hold it loosely.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class, two opening claims. Mel's: nine free-agent pickups and cheap depth make this a title core. Partly supported — Bijan, Dowdle and Skattebo cleared 31 apiece in week six, but that's one column. Reggie's: the scoreboard says GLORY ASSHOLE wins week nine outright. Not supported — that's a projection, 140 to 129.7, not a result yet. The number that actually decides tonight: 1094.2 points for, lowest of the five-and-threes. Verdict goes to whoever built the record, not the forecast.
